sources.snippet: Step 1: Fine-tuning Function Gemma with the Mobile Actions Dataset FunctionGemma is a 270 million parameter model based on the Gemma 3 architecture. It has been trained specifically for function calling, enabling it to translate natural language requests into function calls.
